column1: # Menu strings, one row per language, tab-separated.
#   lang <TAB> submenu label <TAB> item label <TAB> item tooltip
# %s is replaced by the target format in upper case (PNG, JPG, ...).
# The submenu label is what most file managers show; the item label is only
# used where a file manager has no submenus and the entries must stand alone.
# "en" is the fallback and must stay first.
